parsed.title: Contradictory finding-mark for VF-80
parsed.detail: The finding VF-80 is marked as `finding-mark` but the table structure and the content of the finding (which describes a code/verify defect) suggest it is a verification of a finding, yet it is listed as a primary row in a way that conflicts with the `finding-mark` status used for other rows. More critically, the finding VF-80 claims `verdict BLOCKED: unparseable` is the cause, but the row itself is categorized as `code` axis, creating ambiguity in whether the finding is the defect or the verification of the defect.
